item.description: Buyers have built a floor under $BTC. After the slide toward $55k, a dense cluster of bids has formed between $50k and $58k. Support this strong has not been seen since August. Breaking through it would require aggressive sell pressure.

item.title: $BTC is still holding its summer low. The August breakout fully retraced, and pr…
item.description: $BTC is still holding its summer low. The August breakout fully retraced, and price fell back to the June lows. It briefly wicked below this level twice, but every daily candle has closed above. Buyers are defending this level.

item.title: Rumors of AI labs cracking public-key cryptography have put $BTC key exposure in…
item.description: Rumors of AI labs cracking public-key cryptography have put $BTC key exposure in focus. 7.12M BTC now rests on addresses whose public keys are already visible on-chain. The balance sits at a record high, climbing almost uninterrupted since late 2023 alongside price.
